content:
sanjay: Kicking off eu-north3 region bring-up. I pushed a branch regions/eu-north3 with GitOps manifests and a values-eu-north3.yaml for the runtime chart.
ashley: Nice — what GPU SKU are we targeting? A100s or A10s?
sanjay: Target is a mixed pool: A100-80GB reserved for inference heavy lanes, A10g for lower-cost burst capacity. NodePools: gpu-a100-80, gpu-a10g-24.
olivia: Any quota requests filed with cloud for the A100s? those need 48h lead time in eu-north3 last time.
sanjay: Yes, quota ticket #INC-5421 opened yesterday, support confirmed tentative allocation but asked for a capacity reservation request. I'll post the ticket link: https://cloud-provider.example/tickets/INC-5421
mike: For image replication — do we use the central registry mirror or a region-local proxy? we had TTL issues last time.
sanjay: We'll mirror signed images to registry.us-east and registry.eu-north3. image-mirror-bot will start replication for tag v2026-03-15. Using cosign for signatures and SLSA provenance.
image-mirror-bot: replication started: registry.redwood-prod -> registry.eu-north3.redwood (tag: v2026-03-15) :information_source:
ashley: Running through bootstrap checklist: 1) GitOps branch ready, 2) Helm values validated, 3) registry mirror verified, 4) network ACLs/routing, 5) capacity reservation ack, 6) handoff doc updated. Anything to add?
olivia: Add KMS integration check for private deployments, and NAT egress IP whitelist for telemetry.
sanjay: Adding those. Also note we enable automatic prefix/KV cache warming for the runtime in eu-north3 — values flag cache.warm: true in values-eu-north3.yaml.
mike: Quick verify commands before we flip GitOps to production:
```
# check nodes
kubectl --context=eu-north3 get nodes -o wide
# helm dry-run
helm upgrade --install redwood-runtime ./charts/runtime -f values-eu-north3.yaml --namespace redwood --dry-run
# verify image signature
cosign verify --key k8s://projects/redwood/keyrings/release-keys registry.eu-north3.redwood/redwood-runtime:v2026-03-15
```
ashley: For networking, remember to add route for peering to telemetry-prod and to open 443/10250 between infra subnets. Also set the node taints: nvidia.com/gpu=true:NoSchedule for gpu pools.
sanjay: Affirmative. Helm values snippet added:
```
nodeSelector:
  accelerator: a100-80
tolerations:
- key: "nvidia.com/gpu"
  operator: "Equal"
  value: "true"
  effect: "NoSchedule"
autoscaler:
  enabled: true
  minNodes: 3
  maxNodes: 20
```
olivia: Cost note — using A100 reserved + spot A10 mix should keep run cost ~18% below on-demand A100-only baseline. Added to the handoff doc.
image-mirror-bot: replication completed for tag v2026-03-15 (registry.eu-north3.redwood) :white_check_mark:
infra-bot: GitOps pipeline check: branch regions/eu-north3 passed lint and manifests validated. PR: https://git.redwood.com/infra/ops/merge_requests/482
mike: After PR merge, I will watch the pipeline. If any image pullback errors show up, do `kubectl -n redwood describe pod <pod>` and check events — likely imagePullBackOff or registry auth issue.
ashley: Who's on-call for SRE handoff tomorrow during the first traffic ramp? @olivia?
olivia: I can take the morning ramp 06:00-12:00 CET. I'll verify load balancing, autoscaler behaviour and latency SLOs.
sanjay: Plan for 2-step rollout: canary 5% traffic -> monitor token-level latency/cost metrics for 30m -> 50% -> full. Canary policy in console configured under rollouts/eu-north3.
ashley: Sounds good. I'll update the runbook with checklist and add the capacity reservation reference.
sanjay: Great — merging PR now. Will post final pipeline status here. :rocket:
infra-bot: Merge complete. GitOps sync triggered for cluster eu-north3.
infra-bot: Helm release redwood-runtime (v1.14.0) deployed to eu-north3 namespace redwood: upgrade complete.
sanjay: Initial smoke: `kubectl -n redwood get pods` shows runtime components ready=3/3 for canary. Starting canary traffic at 06:10 CET.
mike: Monitoring CPU/GPU sched and model latency dashboards. If we see sustained queue > 40ms request latency for model-lane-1, reduce canary and revert autoscaler threshold.
image-mirror-bot: periodic sync next scheduled in 3h.
olivia: Canary 30m checks: CPU/GPU alloc stable, no image pull issues, latency within SLO. Proceeding to 50% at 06:45 CET.
sanjay: Handing off to Solutions Eng for customer validation at 07:30 CET. Handoff doc: https://docs.redwood.com/handoffs/eu-north3-deploy
ashley: Thanks team. Leaving notes in incident channel if anything funky shows up. :thumbsup:
